title: 米利欧·暖暖小午餐
description: 棕肤小男孩米利欧穿完整绿色旅行衣，背着圆形炉包，在草垫上与温和火灵分享水果。

art_direction.medium: thick wax crayon on warm paper
art_direction.identity: Milio remains a young brown-skinned boy with curly dark hair, bright curious eyes, a friendly round face, and a distinctive large round furnace-like backpack. Keep his green-orange travel clothing fully covering, with short practical boots and a modest loose tunic. His fuemigo companions are tiny smiling warm light creatures, softly contained and never burning him, other people, or nearby objects.
art_direction.scene: He sits on a woven mat and places a slice of fruit on a little leaf plate while one friendly fuemigo peeks from beside the backpack. A second warm spirit hovers a short distance away, leaving his face clear. Keep the garden sunny, the food ordinary, and the mood childlike, curious, and safe.
art_direction.palette: leaf green, warm orange, brown curls, cream
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
